title: 第19章 凡有所获必有所失第20章 白衣女子
content_zh:
白虎真魂，再度发出一声咆哮，山巅如同刮起风暴，阵法光罩上荡漾出一圈又一圈的震动涟漪。
可这一次，余烬的身影却纹丝未动，唯独身上的黑袍被吹得猎猎作响。
余烬面无表情地伸出一指，往前虚空一点，一道黑炎光柱极速射出，瞬间洞穿白虎骸骨的头颅。
像是发出愤怒的低吼，三只眼睛中的魂火中仅剩下眉心处的魂火依旧在燃烧，而且逐渐变得黯淡……
余烬轻描淡写地一步步往前走，神秘的仙笼在他身旁悬浮，缓缓地旋转着，那双黑眸的视线落在真魂仅剩的魂火之上，”不想在这个世界消失，进入仙笼就是你最好的选择！”
残存的真魂之火不断摇曳，仿佛在凝视着少年，片刻后那副骸骨张嘴，似乎要发出愤怒地咆哮！
只是虎啸声还未来得及传出，仙笼上突然亮起点点光芒，一下子便将那团残魂收入笼中！
笼中黑雾涌动眨眼就将其吞噬消失！
看到仙笼终于是将白虎真魂囚禁，余烬心中的大石缓缓落地，然而没有等他松一口气，他的脸上突然露出一抹诡异笑容！
如同蛛网一般的奇异纹路交织在了余烬脸上，面具的笑声突然出现，可这一次不是在脑海中响起，而是从余烬自己嘴中开口。
“不错，你这副躯壳虽然弱小无比，可也能勉强发挥出本尊的一丝力量，怎么样……小蝼蚁，拥有力量的感觉是不是很美妙！？”
余烬脸上出现挣扎的神色，“你，对我做了什么？”
“凡有所获，必有所失！“面具的充满阴冷和戏谑，“你要驾驭本尊的力量，自然要付出代价！”
轰隆！
余烬忽然双膝跪在地上，双拳死死地握成拳头，手上青筋暴起，更恐怖的是那些出现在他脸上的奇异蛛网纹路，正在不停地蠕动着，他的脸仿佛要变成另一个人！
“放弃挣扎吧，待本尊提前吞噬你的意志，获得仙笼认主，若是心情好本尊会考虑替你灭掉你所憎恶的一切，甚至替你毁灭这个世界！哈哈哈……”
面具的声音从余烬嘴中脱口而出，不断冲击他的意识，他的脸甚至因为强烈的抵抗和挣扎而出现扭曲。
就在面具发出放肆笑声，余烬的意识越来越模糊的时候，余烬的脸色反而突然平静下来，他沙哑着声音开口，“呵呵，你真的想要我这副躯壳吗？那就给你好了！”
面具的笑声猛地停顿，连他自己都没反应过来，便轻而易举地吞噬了余烬的意识海！
余烬……不，或者说是面具，他缓缓抬起手掌，看着掌上跳动的火焰，用沙哑的声音阴冷地质问道：“你，刚才在笑什么？”

明明似乎一切都很顺利，他成功提前地获得了那少年的躯壳，可心里却破天荒出现一丝说不清的情绪。
“山巅之上究竟是何方宵小，速速滚出来！”
“敢闯我余氏族山者，死！”
一道道恐怖的声浪滚滚而来，轰得空气震动，“余烬”伸出手指在耳朵上掏了几下，然后一脸不耐烦地歪了歪头。
content_en:
The White Tiger's True Soul roared once again, and a storm seemed to be blowing on the top of the mountain, with ripples of vibrations rippling out of the formation's light shield.
But this time, Yan Yan's figure did not move at all, only the black robe on his body was blown away.
Ember stretched out his finger expressionlessly, moved forward a little, and a black flame beam shot out at a high speed, instantly piercing the skull of the white tiger's skeleton.
Like an angry roar, among the soul fires in the three eyes, only the soul fire between the eyebrows is still burning, and it gradually becomes dim...
Yi Yan walked forward step by step in an understated manner. The mysterious fairy cage was suspended beside him, rotating slowly. The eyes of those black eyes fell on the remaining soul fire of the true soul. "If you don't want to disappear in this world, entering the fairy cage is your best choice!"
The remaining true soul fire kept swaying, as if staring at the boy. After a moment, the skeleton opened its mouth, as if it was about to roar angrily!
But before the roar of the tiger could be heard, a little light suddenly lit up on the fairy cage, and the remaining soul was immediately put into the cage!
The black mist in the cage swallowed it up and disappeared in the blink of an eye!
Seeing that the immortal cage finally imprisoned the true soul of the white tiger, the stone in Yi Yan's heart slowly fell to the ground. However, before he could breathe a sigh of relief, a strange smile suddenly appeared on his face!
Strange lines like spider webs were intertwined on Yi Yan's face, and the mask's laughter suddenly appeared, but this time it did not sound in his mind, but came from Yi Yan's own mouth.
"Yes, although your body is extremely weak, you can still exert a little bit of my power. How about... little ant, doesn't it feel wonderful to have power!?"
A struggling look appeared on Yu Yan's face, "What did you do to me?"
"Everything you gain must be lost!" The mask was full of coldness and jest, "If you want to control my power, you will naturally have to pay a price!"
Boom!
Yan Yan suddenly knelt on the ground, clenched his fists tightly, and veins popped out on his hands. What was even more terrifying was that the strange spider web patterns that appeared on his face were squirming, and his face seemed to be turning into another person!
"Give up your struggle. When I swallow your will in advance and obtain the Immortal Cage to recognize my master, if I am in a good mood, I will consider destroying everything you hate for you, and even destroy the world for you! Hahaha..."
The voice of the mask blurted out from Yu Yan's mouth, constantly impacting his consciousness, and his face even became distorted due to the strong resistance and struggle.
Just when the mask laughed wildly and Yi Yan's consciousness became increasingly blurred, Yi Yan's face suddenly calmed down, and he spoke in a hoarse voice, "Haha, do you really want this body of mine? I'll give it to you then!"
Mask's laughter suddenly stopped, and even he himself didn't react, and it easily swallowed up the sea of consciousness of Ember!
Embers... no, or rather masks. He slowly raised his palms, looked at the flames dancing on them, and asked coldly in a hoarse voice: "What were you laughing at just now?"
Everything seemed to be going well, and he successfully obtained the young man's body in advance, but for the first time, there was an indescribable emotion in his heart.
"Where is Fang Xiaoxiao on the top of the mountain? Get out of here quickly!"
"Anyone who dares to invade our Yu Clan Mountain will die!"
A series of terrifying sounds rolled in, making the air vibrate. "Ember" stretched out his fingers and touched his ears a few times, then tilted his head impatiently.
